user.description: Choose the Glowrium device to set up.

data_description.address: Each line is a lamp heard nearby that has not been set up yet, listed by the name it advertises and its Bluetooth address.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}?

abort.already_in_progress: Configuration flow is already in progress

cannot_connect.message: Failed to send the command to {name} over Bluetooth. The device may be out of range or the Bluetooth adapter busy; a Bluetooth proxy near the device usually fixes this.

home_location_not_set.message: Cannot send the location to {name}: Home Assistant has no home location set (its latitude and longitude are both zero). Set the home location in Home Assistant's settings first, then try again.

lighting_mode_not_read.message: Cannot change this yet: {name} has not reported its current lighting mode. It should populate once the lamp is connected.

link_not_released.message: Cannot send the command to {name}: the previous Bluetooth connection to it could not be closed, and no new one is opened on top of it. If this does not clear by itself, restart Home Assistant; if it comes back after that, the host's Bluetooth stack is holding on to the connection: power-cycle the Bluetooth adapter on the host.

not_running.message: Cannot send the command to {name}: the integration is being reloaded or Home Assistant is stopping. Try again once it is running again.

schedule_not_read.message: Cannot change this yet: {name} has not reported its current schedule. It should populate once the lamp is connected.

bluetooth_stack_stuck.title: The host's Bluetooth stack is holding on to a dead link
bluetooth_stack_stuck.description:
Home Assistant asked the Bluetooth stack on this host to disconnect {name} {count} times in a row and was never answered. That points at the stack holding on to a link that no longer exists - not at the lamp, and not at anything a restart of Home Assistant clears.

Power-cycle the Bluetooth adapter on the host (`bluetoothctl power off`, then `bluetoothctl power on`) or restart its bluetooth service. Until then the lamp is tried less often. This goes away by itself as soon as the lamp answers again.

presets_unconfirmed.title: {name}: the lighting-mode presets are unconfirmed for this model
presets_unconfirmed.description:
{name} names its model as `{model}`, and this integration has no profile for that model. The presets offered under **Lighting mode** are those of the Glowrium G7.

On this model a name may select another preset than it says, or none at all. **Lighting mode** shows what was chosen either way, whether or not the lamp took it as that preset.

What settles it is a report of what each preset does on this lamp, or better a capture of the vendor app switching between them: the guide linked below says what to send and how. Until then the presets stay on offer as they are, and this notice can be ignored.
